## Purpose and scope

Describe the reusable outcome, affected skills and exclusions without private context.

## Before-publication review

A public draft PR is already public. Complete privacy review before pushing; this checklist records that review, not permission to disclose first.

- [ ] New files, commits, messages, metadata, examples, links and attachments reviewed.
- [ ] No personal, confidential or credential-bearing material; examples synthetic or explicitly cleared for public release, never private or confidential source material.
- [ ] Provenance, distribution rights and required attribution checked under the existing license.
- [ ] Material technical limitations and unrun checks stated accurately.
- [ ] Required independent review has an actual result and scope; self-review labeled separately.

## Verification

Commands and results; exact candidate revision or hashes; failures and checks not run. Static checks and text-only probes are not runtime safety evidence.

## Adoption and authority

For substantial infrastructure, link the sanitized reuse decision and any custom-build exception. Otherwise explain why it does not apply. Publication, merge and activation are separate.

See [contribution policy](../CONTRIBUTING.md). Do not attach private raw logs.
